title: Elevators & Laundry Chutes - a 3D clone of Chutes and Ladders...with way more
author: leg18
selftext:
100 squares spiral up a 10-floor tower. Elevators take you up, laundry chutes drop you down, and 20 cards add chaos like Cherry Bombs, falling pianos, alien abductions and a time warp.



I used LibGDX 1.14.2, Java, Android API 36. No asset files: all the 3D is built in code, and the music and 35 sound effects are generated by a Python script. 

 It tested its own builds on a virtual display, screenshotted them, and fixed a crash, a bad camera and cluttered chutes before I saw them. - It simulated 20,000 games and found that one of the two dice choices was a trap, then rebalanced so both average the same speed. - 

The first APK it gave me installed and ran. No Gradle errors, no missing natives. - It found a click in the music loop by analyzing the waveform, since it has no speakers. 

Where it fell short: it never touched my real phone, so feel was on me. It shipped bugs it only caught because it went looking. The art is boxes and cylinders. And the design calls were still mine. Code and APK: [https://github.com/saedarm/ElevatorSlide-GDX](https://github.com/saedarm/ElevatorSlide-GDX)
